prompt: We use Python/FastAPI and want to connect our tracing to MultiTool. We have OpenTelemetry configured already. My API key is mt_sk_abc123 and our deploys use Docker image tags like v2.1.4 so I'll set APP_VERSION to that.

assertions.description: Output tracing.py uses the exact MultiTool endpoint URL
Output tracing.py uses 'api-key' as the header name
Output tracing.py reads API key from MULTI_API_KEY env var
Output tracing.py uses the HTTP exporter, not gRPC (gRPC exporter removed/replaced)
Output tracing.py sets SERVICE_VERSION from APP_VERSION env var
assertions.check: tracing.py references APP_VERSION for the service version attribute

assertions.description: Response reminds user to store API key as env var, not in code
assertions.check: response.md warns against hardcoding the API key and tells user to use an env var

assertions.description: Response explains why APP_VERSION must change with every deploy
assertions.check: response.md explains that APP_VERSION must be unique per deploy for MultiTool version grouping to work
